messages:
Anita (Product): Heads up — roadmap reset: new ship window target is 2026-04-15. We need a quick decision on what is truly required for MVP vs what we should push to v1. Can we do a 10–15m triage here?
Liam (Eng): yes. quick ask: can folks list the top infra/customer asks they care about and rough sprint-level cost?
Maya (SE): From support signals: embeddings cache, model pinning, per-tenant routing, SAML. Ballpark: embeddings cache = 2 sprints to stabilize, model pinning = 1 sprint, per-tenant routing = 1 sprint + infra testing, SAML = 3 sprints (lots of edge cases).
Sofia (Design): We can pare down tenant UI for MVP to a minimal settings page — shipping without full SAML flows is OK for pilot, but the enterprise UX will feel incomplete.
Carlos (Growth): Customer X and two prospects raised SAML as blocker. But Carlos (Growth): they said pilot would be acceptable if we provide dedicated capacity + a short SLA and a roadmap commitment. Might buy time.
Anita (Product): Proposal: MVP = core API endpoints (text+chat+embeddings), model pinning, basic per-tenant routing, minimal tenant UI, the observability surface (latency + cost dashboards). Defer SAML and advanced tenant admin to v1.
Liam (Eng): With that scope: doable if we avoid a big infra refactor. Risk: embeddings cache is the major perf/cost win; if we skip it we pay more per token and hit quota. Can we scope a lightweight cache (prefix-only) for MVP?
Maya (SE): prefix-only cache prototype could be 1 sprint with a follow-on to expand to KV caching. That reduces the perf risk.
Eve (Eng Manager): We can allocate one infra engineer to unblock embeddings cache for 4 weeks. Also recommend a canary plan: model-fallback and region-fallback configured before GA.
Anita (Product): Acceptance criteria proposal for MVP: 1) API parity for core endpoints, 2) model pin pinning works + rollout policy, 3) latency p50 <= 180ms for typical prompts, 4) cost per 1k tokens within 15% of baseline, 5) observability dashboards with per-route cost.
Maya (SE): I'll paste a tiny PR checklist we can require on merge:```
- perf/regression-ci: pass
- token-cost-delta: < 15%
- canary flag present and tested
- rollout and fallback documented
```
Sofia (Design): I'll ship a minimal tenant settings mock by EOD Monday.
Carlos (Growth): I'll draft a customer-facing pilot note offering dedicated capacity + SLA in exchange for SSO being scoped to v1.
Liam (Eng): One ask: if we accept the lightweight cache plan, we still need to reserve time for loadtesting and autoscaling config (1 sprint).
Anita (Product): Decision checkpoint: MVP-light (as proposed) = GO if eng + infra commit. I'll update the roadmap and send a snapshot to GTM and Enterprise by EOD. If we get pushback from sales, we'll re-eval on Wednesday. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder: freeze branch tomorrow 17:00 UTC — coordinate any big infra merges before then.
Eve (Eng Manager): I'll confirm resource pull tomorrow AM and tag owners.
Anita (Product): Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the trimmed milestone list and a single-row tradeoff doc for execs.
